text:
incident-bot: ⚠️ INCIDENT detected - container crashloop in gpu-pool-12 (service: inference-runtime). Reason: segfault in runtime engine during KV-cache restore. Affected: ~8 pods across 3 nodes. Customer impact: increased 500s for several customers, highest for 'acme-inc'. Pager: https://pager.example/INC-4321

alice: I'm on it, grabbing logs + core dumps. tagging @bob for kernel logs.

bob: got the nodes: node-12a node-12b node-13c. journal shows repeated 'segfault at 0 ip ... in vllm::kv_cache_restore' and GPU driver messages: `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79` around failure windows.

carol: can we tell the routing layer to fall back to model-variant:llama-13b-cpu or smaller for affected customers? need a quick mitigation.

alice: yes, rolling a routing policy to move 100% of traffic from gpu-pool-12 to gpu-pool-9 for non-enterprise tenants. starting now.

pagerduty-bot: alice acknowledged the pager (on-call).

dave: stack trace from core on node-12a: ```
#0 0x7f9c1a2b in vllm::KVCache::restore() at kv_cache.cpp:128
#1 0x7f9c1a8f in runtime::Engine::init_kv() at engine.cpp:432
#2 0x7f9c2b00 in main_loop()
```
looks like a null pointer in fused kernel path.

erin: quick check: is this the new TRT optimization we rolled yesterday? last deploy touched TensorRT fused attention.

alice: yes, can confirm. Deploy `trt-fused-optimizations` rolled to gpu-pool-12 at 02:12 UTC.

bob: kernel logs also show memory map differences before/after restart, but no OOM killer entries. CUDA reports `illegal memory access` prior to segfault.

carol: mitigation plan: 1) cordon node-12a/b/c 2) evict pods on those nodes 3) restart with env `DISABLE_FUSED_KERNELS=1` for runtime image 4) canary rollout of patched runtime `runtime:v2.1.1-hotfix` to 2 pods

alice: doing step 1&2 now. cordoning node-12a/b/c. evicting non-critical workloads.

bob: pulling a debug container on node-12a to reproduce with `gdb --args /app/runtime --restore-kv`. If someone can drop a repro prompt that triggers large KV restore that would help.

dave: repro prompt attached (short): "long context chat..." triggers large past-key-values. trying now.

alice: restarted evicted pods on node-9 with routing change in place. 5/5 pods healthy there. customer error rate for acme-inc dropped from 18% to 3%.

erin: building `runtime:v2.1.1-hotfix` with fused-kernel toggles and additional null checks. will push an image in ~10m.

carol: can we also set a temporary smart-routing rule to prefer CPU-variant for affected enterprise customers until hotfix is validated?

alice: applied smart-routing: enterprise-tier -> gpu-pool-9 (no fused trt). non-enterprise -> existing fallback.

bob: debug run with gdb shows null pointer at kv_cache.cpp:127 when `kv_cache_->entries` is empty after fast-path resume. suspect race when fused kernel writes cache while restore is happening.

dave: spike of restarts stopped after cordon + routing change. no further crashes on node-9. good sign.

erin: pushed hotfix image to staging `runtime:v2.1.1-hotfix` with `DISABLE_FUSED_KERNELS` defaulted to true and an additional guard. starting canary rollout to 2 pods in gpu-pool-12 (isolated).

alice: canary pods are up. running smoke tests (long-context generation).

carol: customer-impact update: acme-inc incidents reduced to baseline, other affected customers also showing improvement. still mark as P1 until all nodes stable.

bob: attaching minimal repro log snippet: ```
[2026-03-17T02:40:21Z] [runtime] restore_kv() size=0 -> hitting fused_write path unexpectedly
[2026-03-17T02:40:21Z] CUDA ERROR: illegal memory access
[2026-03-17T02:40:21Z] Segmentation fault (core dumped)
```

erin: canary passed smoke tests for 30m. recommending staged rollout across remaining pods in gpu-pool-12 with 10% increments and 5m observation windows.

alice: rolling out hotfix to remaining pods in pool-12 at 02:58 UTC, monitoring.

pagerduty-bot: alice set status to 'mitigating' and updated incident channel.

dave: after rollout, observed 0 segfaults in the last 15m on pool-12. routing remains in fallback state for enterprise until all pods confirmed.

carol: postmortem notes to capture: trigger = fused-TRT optimization combined with KV-restore race; mitigation = routing fallback, cordon/evict, hotfix image disabling fused kernels + guard; customer impact = transient 12-20% error spikes for some customers, highest acme-inc ~18% for ~22 minutes.

alice: handing off to next on-call for watch and postmortem follow-up. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: incident acknowledged by next-oncall (bob). incident-bot: marking as 'under review' once monitoring window completes.

bob: I'll own the postmortem and coordinate with runtime team for a proper fix on the fused path. scheduling follow-up 1hr post-incident.

alice: final status: routing reverted for non-enterprise, enterprise still pinned to safe pool until tomorrow AM. closing active mitigation.
